public_rationale: This is an open-ended prediction made on the evaluation date. The filing establishes reinstatement and promised oversight, but not the predicted escalation and eventual distress. No decisive event meets the early-resolution rule. The language about exceeding readers' imaginations remains unmeasurable even under the ordinary business reading.
limitations: No deadline, defined group, or magnitude threshold.
Reinstatement preceding later distress would not by itself establish causation.
The ordinary reading cannot settle the literal rhetorical comparison.

our_interpretation: Them refers to the AI industry leaders discussed in the surrounding passage.
The testable ordinary reading is that Huang's reinstatement encourages greater financial risk and cash consumption, disregard of warnings, and resulting severe business distress.
More requires comparison with behavior before reinstatement.
No deadline is supplied. The comparison with what a reader would imagine supplies no measurable speed or severity threshold.
Any verdict on the ordinary business-distress reading would not establish the literal comparison with a reader's expectations.
criteria.support_condition: Subsequent records establish a broader pattern of increased risk and cash consumption, ignored warnings, and severe business distress, with evidence that reinstatement encouraged the changed behavior.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A sufficiently complete account of the relevant episode establishes reduced risk and cash consumption, adherence to warnings, and no predicted distress attributable to reinstatement. Mere survival for a finite period cannot defeat an unlimited forecast.
